lessons_used: Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though one test showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) had mixed results: the pet preview screen won with a large gain (+15.4%), but the quiz screen significantly hurt performance (-7.7%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), tutorials (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

candidates.title: Story Screen Animated Companion Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a centered spotlight view featuring animated companion showcases that highlight core pet behaviors.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean completion time (514s) and 76.2% conversion, showing a need for an immediate engaging visual hook.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen while maintaining its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns and tutorials historically showed no positive effect or slight losses.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to explicitly reassure returning users that logging into their account restores missing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making post-sign-in data loss anxiety a key friction point.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to keep your pets synced
sign_in.body: Log into your account to instantly restore your existing companions, items, and pet progress.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to reassure returning users without violating any pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence, but copy changes historically produce negligible lift.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Split Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick friend screen layout into a split comparison view featuring side-by-side choice cards and visual previews.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 70.5% conversion rate and takes a mean of 1017s; a side-by-side comparative layout reduces decision fatigue.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout while preserving the core function of selecting a pet.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns showed neutral to negative performance in prior tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display a quick reference carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic mouse clicks and shortcut commands for desktop pets.
candidates.why: Wait screen info updates proved effective in earlier tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), and support received multiple complaints regarding unclear pet controls.

components.text: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open interaction controls and options.

guard.reason: Adds desktop control tips to the waiting screen, which is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen info consistently drives solid gains and addresses explicit support complaints.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Checklist Guide on Home Intro
candidates.change: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist flow that guides users through verifying their pet's desktop spawn.
candidates.why: The final onboarding step drops to 64.8% completion, and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or failing to open.

home_intro.headline: Launch Your Pet onto the Desktop

components.text:
1. Confirm pet appearance on desktop
2. Try clicking pet
3. Test right-click menu

candidates.title: Pet Customization Sound & Voice Selection Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet voice and sound selection screen prior to photo upload so users can pick companion audio traits.
candidates.why: Adding customization screens during adoption previously yielded a +15.4% conversion increase by boosting attachment to the pet.

new_pet_sounds.headline: Choose Companion Voice
new_pet_sounds.body: Pick the sound effects and voice personality for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adds a new pet voice selection screen into onboarding while preserving all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: New customization screens have high upside potential but carry mixed historical risks.

candidates.title: Quick Start Path Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Add an inline guidance hint explaining that pet traits and selected paths can be easily modified later in settings.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s (vs 8s median), indicating users get stuck trying to make a permanent choice.

choose_path.hint: You can change your path choices and pet personality at any time from the app settings.

guard.reason: Adds an informational guidance hint to the choose path screen.

candidates.score_note: Hints on choose_path previously measured a -2.2% decline in conversion.

candidates.title: Centered Single-Column Sign In Layout
candidates.change: Change the sign-in screen to a centered single-column layout to reduce visual noise and simplify login.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion sits at 72.9% with a high mean completion time of 567s, suggesting visual distraction during authentication.

guard.reason: Simplifies sign-in layout without removing functionality or breaking onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Layout changes showed no clear positive effect in earlier experiments.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Troubleshooting Headline
candidates.change: Update the home intro headline and body with explicit troubleshooting steps if the pet does not automatically display on screen.
candidates.why: The finish step has the highest drop rate among final screens (64.8%), driven partly by users whose pets fail to appear visually.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: If your pet isn't visible right away, check your system tray menu or press Ctrl+Alt+P to show it.

guard.reason: Updates copy on the home intro screen to assist with desktop placement troubleshooting.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step at low cost, but copy tweaks rarely produce large gains.

candidates.title: Pet Voice Command Tips on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add interactive tips on the waiting screen demonstrating how to talk to and command the pet once it arrives on desktop.
candidates.why: The home stage takes a long mean time (2336s), and users frequently ask support how to interact or talk with their pet after setup.

components.text: Tip: Click the pet speech bubble or press Enter to start chatting with your companion.

guard.reason: Adds voice command interaction tips to the waiting screen while keeping its initialization indicator.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen enhancements have proven effective and directly target user confusion.
